comment: A second input is configured with no jack widget on the panel, so no cable and no click can reach it, and it gets no line. All five comb jacks and the two partial-count jacks are read monophonic although the oscillator is polyphonic, OscA1.cpp:330-350, so one voltage shapes the comb for every voice. The partials above the Cutoff setting are left out rather than filtered, which is what keeps the oscillator free of aliasing.
